name: Polyphemus
poseidonRelation: Son of Poseidon and the mymph Thoosa
summary: A one-eyed Cyclops blinded by Odysseus.
keyMyths: Odysseus and his men were trapped in his cave (Odyssey,book 9).
Odysseus blinded him with a heated olive stake.
Odysseus told him his name was 'Nobody'.
Polyphemus prayed to poseidon to make Odysseus's journey long and painful.
